inspection.classification: Three business scenarios fail (return caps twice, cumulative inspection once); two failures assert a provisional receipt counter, then absent and never implemented. The final design stores the decision on PurchaseIssue to preserve delivery observations. Not five independent production defects.

limits: Five additional stock/preparation cases and two historical/split inspection cases were added after these diagnostics
Failing assertions are not a count of independent vulnerabilities
